## Schema

### Optional

- `entity_name` (String)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `entity_id` (String) The id of the Jamf Pro object that should be added to the onboarding workflow for end users. Use this in conjunction with the selfServiceEntityType. For example, if the policy with id 132 should be added to onboarding, then entityId should be 132 and selfServiceEntityType should be OS_X_POLICY.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `priority` (Number)
- `scope_description` (String)
- `self_service_entity_type` (String)
- `site_description` (String)
